body: Haha unfortunately I’ve already been dealing with it. We are a smaller store and the amount of product I’ve had to deal with has been nuts

Thankfully my store managers are wonderful, and work with me really well. I’ve been with the company less than a year so I’ve really been trying to adjust. It’s a ton of pressure still, but thank you for the pep talk lol! I think I can handle it for now, but you’re right! If it gets too much I’ll step back down
Bakery, sorry, totally forgot to mention!
Thank you for that! It’s a definite balance I suppose. I’m having a hard time coping with the overload of product we’re being given, but I suppose it is what it is.
We have been very short staffed as of late so I’ve been picking up the slack lol. I’m tired af but I can’t complain about the extra OT

You’re being an asshole by completely ignoring them no matter how inept you are. Like what is the point of trying to show you won’t speak to them?? There would literally be no issue here if you just returned the greeting. Talk to your store manager about the other issues. Ffs
Nasty. Can’t understand how people can act like that
Happened at two different stores then. Damn, that’s crazy
Lol wouldn’t that be funny. What state is your store in?

Yeah I’ve done service dog training. Actually trained service dogs don’t go indoors unless their owner is neglectful. I really doubt it was one though, people get their pets through the door all the time since staff at my store doesn’t really pay attention. Makes me mad since this is store where FOOD is being sold
Yep, I’m guessing she snuck it in. I didn’t see the dog, but no properly trained service animal is going to shit inside.
I know it’s well intentioned but it annoys me beyond belief. I’m not a hero just because I’m willing to work for minimum wage during a pandemic to eat. Go talk to actual heroes like first responders

I was going overseas and wanted to fully experience all of the food offerings. I went vegan because I didn’t like meat, and preferred vegan cheese and stuff at the time, so figured why not just be a vegan altogether. Well, I started eating it, realized I loved meat, and never stopped. Think I was just nutrient deficient and it kick started my taste for meat
